Resistance training plus leucine-rich animal protein helps preserve muscle
Other lasting issues: acid reflux, vision loss, hair loss, pancreatitis
videos.watch_why: Concrete percentages and mechanisms on muscle loss vs fat regain; actionable mitigation steps, not generic warning.

No need to strip; soap does not remove polymerized seasoning
